Subject: Request: evidence & subsidy for VPC pilot

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team here is excited about Redwood’s private VPC option. We have a security gating checklist to complete before we can spin up an isolated pilot. Two asks from our side so we can move to an internal approval: 

- A short SOC2 summary and a checklist of the network configuration you expect on our side (we’ll share this with infra).
- Confirmation whether Redwood can provide a sandbox subsidy (credits) for an isolated 4-week pilot while we complete procurement and risk review.

We’re on a tight timeline — our security committee meets next Wednesday. Would it be possible to get the evidence and a decision on a small credit package (roughly $10k) before then?

Appreciate it,
Alice

Dylan / Marcus — forwarding Alice’s ask. Quick notes:

- I reviewed the attachment (SOC2 summary) and the standard VPC checklist. No high-risk items — this looks like a typical security-gated POC.
- Approvals: I can sign off on a trial subsidy up to $12,000 for a 4-week isolated pilot, conditional on:
  1) CareBridge accepts Redwood’s standard pilot MSA + Data Processing Addendum (DPA).
  2) Security evidence (SOC2 summary) is acknowledged and we receive the completed network_setup_checklist back from their infra team.
  3) We receive a short mutual action plan (MAP) with dates (start/end), and a PO or PO-commit email for the credit to be applied to the account.

If those conditions are met, Stephanie will authorize the subsidy and I’ll ask Finance to reserve the credit. Marcus — can you confirm onboarding capacity the week of June 2 if they sign?

Thanks,
Stephanie

Head of Partnerships & Sales Programs, Redwood Inference
